verdict.rationale: ClickHouse Cloud offers a CLI/API to programmatically create and manage cloud-managed clusters and resources, plus usage-based pricing that scales compute to zero when idle, which supports cost-efficient fleet-style provisioning. However, there is no direct evidence describing a pattern for spinning up thousands of isolated per-agent/tenant databases, no documented multi-tenant isolation guidance, and no explicit 'fleet management' API for bulk database lifecycle at that scale. missing for 10: explicit multi-tenant/isolated-database-per-agent provisioning docs, bulk/fleet management API examples, and evidence of cost/performance at thousands-of-databases scale.
